entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about an order I placed a little while ago. I'd like to start a return for a helmet.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your order number, please?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Aero Helmet, delivered on October 16th. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference. The online pictures made the color look like a matte gray, but it's much shinier in person. It's just not what I was looking for. The box is still unopened, so it's in brand new condition.
I understand completely. Sometimes the lighting in photos can be a bit deceiving. Let me just confirm our return policy for you.

Alright, I've checked and you're well within our 90-day return window. I can definitely process this for you. I've just emailed a prepaid return shipping label to the address on file. You'll receive a full refund once our warehouse receives the item.

That's great news, thank you. I do appreciate how simple that was. Since I am sending this back and plan to order a different helmet, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for my next purchase, just to make up for the trouble?

I'm glad we could get the return authorized for you. I understand your request, but unfortunately, I'm not able to provide discount codes for returns based on a color preference. However, the refund will be processed promptly, and we certainly have other models that might be a better fit. Your safety on the road is our top priority, and we want to ensure you're happy with your gear.
I figured it was worth asking. No problem. Thanks for sending the label through so quickly.
Of course. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
